methods.description: Identify available pronumeral products including1 and the whole product.
Combine each positive numerical factor with each available pronumeral factor.
Write powers as repeated pronumerals and include each possible lower power only once.
Check coefficient factors and available pronumerals, then multiply by the partner to verify.
Combine coefficient factors with1, each individual pronumeral and their product.
